home.description: Create abstract masterpieces with fun techniques like pouring, spinning, and boxing. No artistic skills needed! Perfect for individuals, couples, and groups.

home.what_we_offer_intro: Pour it, spin it, throw it—create without fear. No skills needed. Paint a canvas for your wall or customize clothes you'll wear for years. Pure play, real art. Every session is private: the studio is reserved exclusively for your group.
home.activity_1_description: Dive into an unforgettable painting experience where fun meets creativity. Choose between two approaches—pouring & spinning techniques, or gloves, drips, spray, and playful tools like balloons and tennis balls—to create a vibrant abstract artwork. This activity is priced by canvases, not by the number of people. It's more flexible and affordable: decide whether to create one shared artwork together or let each member of your group paint their own!

home.our_team_greeting: Hi, I'm Alexandra. I lead the sessions myself for now, and my main support and "team" is my family—my husband and our two cats.
home.our_team_story: I spent too long being afraid of making mistakes, and that blocked my creativity. That's why I created SplashPlay—a space where play and experimentation come first. I want you to be able to create without that fear. Here, we focus on curiosity, the flow of creative energy, and, in the end, pure joy.
home.our_team_invitation: I'd love to meet you at the studio and create something together.

main.why_fun_description: Forget about paintbrushes. In our studio you'll try fun and unconventional techniques to create your abstract masterpiece, including:

pouring.title: Pouring
pouring.description: Pour different colors and watch them mix forming hypnotic patterns.

spinning.title: Spinning
spinning.description: Create radial designs by spinning your canvas after applying paint.

boxing.title: Boxing
boxing.description: Box your way to artistic expression with paint-covered boxing gloves.

balloons.title: Balloons
balloons.description: Create playful splash patterns by popping paint-filled balloons over the canvas.

balls.title: Balls
balls.description: Create vibrant splatters by throwing paint-dipped padel balls against the canvas.

guns.title: Water Guns
guns.description: Create color explosions by shooting paint with fun water guns on the canvas.

dripping.title: Dripping
dripping.description: Create unique strokes by letting paint drip freely on the canvas, pure Pollock style.

surprise.title: Surprise
surprise.description: Discover our secret technique: a surprise experience that transforms the canvas into pure fun and color.

techniques.zona_pouring_description: Intimate and calm area, perfect for immersing yourself in the flow of color and letting the creative process guide you, exploring every detail with calm.
techniques.zona_splash_description: Dynamic and fun space where you can experiment with more physical techniques. Perfect for letting go of control and creating together without limits.
techniques.more: And many more! Try any of these or invent your own!

reviews.sveta:
A great creative space where my friends and I not only painted and had fun, but also discovered something about ourselves.

I was eager to try different techniques and styles — I’m definitely coming back! Highly recommended!
reviews.mario: We had an incredible time here! I had never painted before, but the atmosphere was so playful and creative that somehow, I created a piece that now proudly hangs in my home
reviews.eliseo: We spent a very fun afternoon as a team, and some beautiful things came out — even from me, and I don’t have much artistic talent.
reviews.anastasia:
My friends and I just created patterns and designs from our imagination.

It was so much fun and fascinating to discuss afterward what each painting might symbolize.
reviews.jorje:
We went as a family and had a great time. They gave us overalls, shoe covers, and gloves so we could paint without getting stained.

The space is well-prepared: there are protected walls, quality materials, and many options to experiment with paint
reviews.jordi:
I went with my 6-year-old niece and it was a very pleasant experience.

The facilitator was very attentive and guided us through the whole process with great patience, flexible in the use of techniques, and very skilled at showing us how to work with the techniques and colors, especially for two people who know nothing about painting.

Both my niece and I enjoyed it a lot.
reviews.aleix: A very fun and highly recommended experience! Alexandra guided us throughout the activity and we ended up with a fantastic painting. Thank you!!
reviews.aurora:
We chose this activity for our team-building event, and it turned out to be a fantastic idea! It’s not only fun and liberating, but also a wonderful way to truly bond with your colleagues.

Everyone adds their own creative touch to the canvas, and by the end, you’ve all created unique pieces of art together. Highly recommended — both for colleagues and friends!
reviews.semih: This was a perfect gift for my wife for our wedding anniversary. We had a great session and experience with Alexandra. I’m sure we will come back!
reviews.kate:
Today I’ve got the amazing experience. Me and my husband decided to organize our he date at this studio and it was the best decision ever. We created together, giggling and chattered.

Really recommend 🫶
reviews.marie: It was an incredible experience ! The concept is amazing and Alexandra drives the whole session with creativity, joy and kindness. It's awesome! I will definitively come back.
reviews.alina: Had so much fun at the workshop! Love that you can make basically anything you want using many different techniques. For me the process was the best part and the result was the bonus 💗
reviews.katia:
We had an incredible time here! My friends and I joined a painting workshop, and it was the best — joyful, inspiring, warm, and fun! I had never painted before, this was my very first time with brushes and colors.

But the atmosphere was so cozy, playful, and creative that somehow, while laughing and drinking tea, I created a piece that now proudly hangs in my home — and I genuinely love it with all my heart. Pure magic! Many, many thanks!

corporate.activity_teambuilding_description: Your team will enjoy a playful and collaborative activity designed to spark creativity, connection, and lots of fun — no artistic skills required! There is an equal number of tools, people, and canvases. At the beginning, each participant draws a random tool — it could be a brush, sponge, roller, straw, or even something unexpected, like a ball or water gun. Everyone paints for 5 minutes using their assigned tool. Then canvases rotate clockwise, and tools rotate counterclockwise. In the end, each person will have tried every tool, and every artwork becomes a collective creation touched by everyone's style and energy!
corporate.activity_teambuilding_included: Canvases, all paints & materials, protective gear, welcome drinks, personal guidance and a studio space exclusively for your group, optional photos/videos via WhatsApp. Paintings ready after 24–48 hours.
corporate.howitworks_toggle: Team building special: view full program
corporate.howitworks_content:
🕒 DATE & TIME: Contact us to book a convenient day and time for the session. The duration is about 2–2.5 hours.

🧤 WHAT TO WEAR: We provide protective suits and shoe covers, but we still recommend wearing clothes you don't mind getting paint on — or bringing an outfit to change into.

🥤 WELCOME & INTRO: Upon arrival, each participant receives a welcome drink. We'll briefly explain the session, the materials, and how it all works.

Your creative challenge program

🙋‍♀️ There is an equal number of tools, people, and canvases.
🔨 At the beginning, each participant draws a random tool — it could be a brush, sponge, roller, straw, or even something unexpected, like a ball or water gun.
⏲️ Everyone paints for 5 minutes using their assigned tool.

Then the magic begins

🕰️ Canvases rotate clockwise, and tools rotate counterclockwise. In the end, each person will have tried every tool, and every artwork becomes a collective creation touched by everyone's style and energy.

After the rotations

🖌️ Each participant will have 5 final minutes to add finishing touches with any tool they like.
Then each participant draws a number and receives one of the paintings as a keepsake. If they wish, they can swap artworks with another teammate — because sometimes you fall in love with someone else's piece.

To close the experience

📷 We take photos of all the paintings and upload them to AI to generate fun and unexpected interpretations. Then we read them aloud — a playful and inspiring way to end the session, full of laughter and meaning.

🖼️ THE FINAL RESULT: At the end, each participant takes home one artwork created together with their team. Paintings can be picked up after 24–48 hours, once they're fully dry.

We look forward to welcoming your team to this colourful experience!
